d:
In this Bihar Adda conversation, Bhojpuri actress Neelam Giri opens up about her experience on Bigg Boss. She recalls an incident involving Salman Khan and reveals why she said, "Mujhse Bhool Hui." Neelam talks about her interaction with Salman Khan, her Bigg Boss journey, the lessons she learned, and her journey from Bhojpuri entertainment to Bollywood. Watch this interesting conversation from Bihar Adda as Neelam Giri shares some lesser-known stories from her life and career.
Production: Neha
Video Editor: Ravi Gangwar
